tb_path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the directory containing Gaviota .gtb tablebase files (e.g., 5-piece endgame databases). Must contain at least one .gtb file.

io_threads.description: Maximum number of parallel I/O threads for reading tablebase files. Increase for high-core-count systems or large databases; keep ≤ CPU core count for best efficiency.

use_compression.description: Whether to use Gaviota's compression scheme. Enabled (true) reduces memory usage but increases CPU load during table lookup. Disable (false) for maximum speed on systems with ample RAM.

cache_size.description: Maximum cache size (in MiB) for decompressed tablebase chunks. Larger caches reduce disk I/O and improve response latency, but consume RAM.

preload.description: If true, preloads all tablebase files into memory at service startup. Use only on systems with sufficient RAM (e.g., ≥ 1 GiB for 5-piece databases).

preload_files.description: List of specific tablebase filenames (e.g., ['KQvK.gtb', 'KRNvK.gtb']) to preload instead of all files. Only honored if preload=true.

items.description: A .gtb tablebase filename (e.g., 'KQvK.gtb') to preload on startup.

fallback_path.description: Optional secondary path to check if the primary TB_PATH is missing or empty. Usually not needed unless running multiple tablebase sets.
